en.title: Index of the Maximum Element After Independent Left Rotations
en.description:
The array consists of distinct positive integers. Each query independently rotates the original array to the left r times and returns the new 0-based index of the maximum element; rotations do not accumulate across queries.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and numeric ranges missing from the original text are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The first line contains n m, the second line contains n distinct array values, and the third line contains m rotation counts. 1≤n,m≤500000, 1≤array value≤10⁹, 0≤rotation count≤10⁹.
en.output: First output m, then output m 0-based indices of the maximum element.
en.explanation:
The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 3
1 0 2; 3
0 2 2; 2
0 0. The examples were checked by independent enumeration, state search, or direct simulation.
hints: First find the original index p of the maximum element; for each query, output (p−r) mod n directly, normalized to 0..n−1.
